For many computer operating systems the root (administrator or superuser) account is a special user with complete access to all files and commands. \nIn the context of Android, root access allows the user to have complete control over the device. Users with root access can cause damage and caution should be used.

The most common reasons for gaining root access are: Remove Unwanted Applications, Increase Performance, Perform Full Data Backup, Connect WiFi and USB Tether, Use Custom Themes, and run the latest Android OS. \nAll benefits gained from root access vary based on the hardware and software of the device.
